APPROVE — bounded ledger S1 repair at 0e2a85e447acbd827c004f3f58d0e5a567f88da1, tree b0a4ba870a2b645fd8cacb6babb03181b21e14c6, delta from objected7550a6ef662bdcf8ea65adfd81bf4616b55ffeab. This resolves the reproduced missing-dispersion input binding finding for this exact SHA. Implementation ownership remains codex-eyes4s.

LedgerReverification.scala:127 now runs compareInput before constructing VerifiedAdmission. Lines160-204 compare ordered trial count/keys, Agreement frame/clock, fixation cardinality and structural Fixation (span, centre, sample support and full dispersion status/value/method/evidence), source identity and sample ranges. Lines205-243 compare complete retained recording metadata and Sample structural values including gaze/pupil/time/lineage. Checked the underlying Fixation/Recording/Sample declarations and Scanpath constructors: extent/transitions derive from compared fixations, and source-series data is accounted for. InputEvidenceMismatch at149 and300 carries source/component/indices and both operands. Diagnostic is appended; docs accurately limit this API to synchronous verification. CsvCursor and TidyResult are unchanged by this repair.

Independent verification in separate detached .claude/worktrees/review-ledger-repair-0e2a85e:
1. Original IndependentLedgerReviewSuite copied byte-for-byte, SHA25630dd6e9a954b657ec71fdd85d1116340d0ef5a66fba8802a8486f206dfe99da0. Unchanged public codec-roundtripped dispersion42 counterexample now refuses. All original seven checks pass on JVM and JS, including 19,531-string parser differential, 2,051 quoted/Unicode/CRLF rows, 2,050-record rejection boundaries, interpretation and inventory guards. Original reviewer copy and red receipts untouched.
2. Fresh LedgerRepairPositionReviewSuite checks an independent eight-trial/three-fixation fixture. Equal separately decoded input accepts after source relocation. All48 fabricated dispersion variants per platform (8 trials x3 fixations x2 methods) preserve old hash and pure ledger acceptance, survive codec roundtrip, and refuse with exact source, nonzero trial/fixation locations, expected/actual values and message operands.
3. Existing LedgerReverificationSuite14 tests passed on each platform, including five ledger-forgery vectors and expanded recording/dispersion evidence regression. JVM CsvCursor3,SourceAdmission4,IoDiagnosticCatalog10 passed.

Commands (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, sbt -J-Xmx8g): ioJVM/testOnly eyes4s.io.IndependentLedgerReviewSuite eyes4s.io.LedgerReverificationSuite eyes4s.io.CsvCursorSuite eyes4s.io.SourceAdmissionSuite eyes4s.io.IoDiagnosticCatalogSuite; ioJS/testOnly eyes4s.io.IndependentLedgerReviewSuite eyes4s.io.LedgerReverificationSuite; then ioJVM/testOnly eyes4s.io.LedgerRepairPositionReviewSuite and ioJS/testOnly eyes4s.io.LedgerRepairPositionReviewSuite. Total63 checks (38+21+2+2), zero failures/skips. focused.log exit0/86.925215s; positions.log exit0/22.944669s, metadata alongside under /private/tmp/eyes4s-ledger-review-0e2a85e. New probe source and original fingerprint retained. Harmless existing no-tag git-describe message and JDK Unsafe deprecation noted; no Scala compilation warning failure.

Scope limits: no production source edits, author/main/UI-D changes, ownership/status changes, acceptance, full audit, publishing consumer, current-main integration, bounded execution/cancellation or manifest claim. Final reviewed-integration landing gate remains required. This verdict does not transfer to another SHA.
